kebab_example: aliyun ice update-ad-insertion --name my_ad --content-url-prefix https://source.com/ --slate-ad-url http://storage.com/slate1.mp4 --config-aliases player_params.p1_:_1_:_abc --cdn-content-segment-url-prefix http://cdn.com/ --cdn-ad-segment-url-prefix http://cdn.com/ --ad-marker-passthrough ON --personalization-threshold 5 --ads-url http://ads.com/ad10param1=_palyer_params.p1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAdInsertion

parameters.help_en: The configuration name, which cannot be modified
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The URL prefix for the source content. HTTP and HTTPS are supported. The maximum length is 512 characters
parameters.help_zh: 内容URL前缀，支持http/https协议，最长支持512个字符
parameters.name: content_url_prefix

parameters.help_en: The HTTP or HTTPS URL of the slate ad. Only MP4 format is supported. The maximum length is 2,048 characters
parameters.help_zh: slate广告URL，支持http/https协议，只支持MP4类型文件(.mp4)，最长支持2048个字符
parameters.name: slate_ad_url

parameters.help_en: A JSON string that specifies the player parameter variables and aliases. Format: { "player\_params.{name}": { "{key}": "{value}" } }. You can add up to 20 player\_params.{name} entries. The name field can be up to 150 characters in length. Each player parameter can include up to 50 key-value pairs. A key can be up to 150 characters long, and a value can be up to 500 characters
parameters.help_zh: 动态配置别名，json字符串，其中player_params.{name}最多添加20个，name部分限制150个字符长度，每个player_params.xxx下最多添加50对key-value，key限制150个字符长度，value限制500个字符长度，例： { "player_params.{name}": { "{key}": "{value}" } }
parameters.name: config_aliases

parameters.help_en: The CDN prefix for content segments. HTTP and HTTPS are supported. The maximum length is 512 characters
parameters.help_zh: 视频内容分片的CDN前缀，支持http/https协议，最长支持512个字符
parameters.name: cdn_content_segment_url_prefix

parameters.help_en: The CDN prefix for ad segments. HTTP and HTTPS are supported. The maximum length is 512 characters
parameters.help_zh: 广告分片的CDN前缀，支持http/https协议，最长支持512个字符
parameters.name: cdn_ad_segment_url_prefix

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable ad marker passthrough. Default value: OFF.

Valid values:

- OFF: Disable.

- ON: Enable
parameters.name: ad_marker_passthrough

parameters.help_en: Specifies the maximum duration of underfilled time allowed in an ad break. Unit: seconds. Default value: 8 seconds
parameters.help_zh: 个性化配置阈值，单位秒，不填默认8秒
parameters.name: personalization_threshold

parameters.help_en: The request URL of the ad decision server (ADS). HTTP and HTTPS are supported. The maximum length is 2,048 characters
parameters.help_zh: 广告策略服务器URL，支持http/https协议，最长支持2048个字符
parameters.name: ads_url
